title: Trial biostatistics toolkit
description: One private copy includes all local modules and their fictional starter data. The external eCRF apps remain a separate repository.

modules.title: Open Study Tracker
modules.summary: Track deliverables, stable IDs, owners, dates, status and change history. Choose an offline workspace or the guided shared tracker.
modules.persistence: Offline edits stay in this browser until exported as JSON/CSV. Shared mode stores its database and settings outside the toolkit workspace ZIP; preserve them through the tracker’s separate backup controls.
modules.customization: Create your own task records in the browser. For shared use, the existing wizard configures accounts, access and optional email.
modules.limits: Operational records only. Offline imports use the last supplied values; shared editing checks row versions. SMTP delivery and shared hosting need your own settings.

modules.title: Continuity and handoff workspace
modules.summary: Turn recurring jobs, owners, backups and runbooks into coverage risks and a handoff packet.
modules.persistence: Uses browser localStorage. Export JSON or CSV before changing browser, machine or project; browser storage is not a project backup.
modules.customization: Enter or import your job inventory, choose the coverage scenario, and print or download the handoff packet.
modules.limits: The page makes no network requests. Browser storage is tied to the browser and origin; use exports to keep projects separate.

modules.title: Worked bioequivalence study
modules.summary: Reproduce six stages of a synthetic 2x2 crossover: design, SAP, ADaM, analysis, QC and number-checked CSR text.
modules.runtime: R, study package lockfile and Quarto

actions.label: Restore study packages
actions.description: Restores the study lockfile; this may download and compile packages.

actions.label: Run synthetic study
actions.description: Regenerates the selected private project’s synthetic outputs.

modules.persistence: Stage output files and run logs stay in your private project; export the project to retain the input, code and results together.
modules.customization: Start with reproduction. The SAP settings JSON is generated and overwritten by run_all.R; use Open folder or Open in editor to review and adapt the source R code before implementing a new design or source-data mapping.
modules.limits: The study is synthetic and always regenerates its example data. QC is same-author re-derivation. No conformant SDTM, define.xml, ADRG or submission package is produced.

modules.title: PK, NCA and bioequivalence sandbox
modules.summary: Generate eight ADaM-shaped domains and calculate PK, NCA, bioequivalence and safety summaries on a seeded example.
modules.persistence: Generated CSVs and the job log stay in the private project.
modules.customization: Open the project code to review priors and the simulation design. The run button regenerates the documented example; it is not a general source-data analysis form.
modules.limits: Synthetic ADaM-shaped data with home-grown checks. NCA conventions and the simple model have stated limits; this is not CDISC conformance or a validated analysis.

modules.title: Residual carryover study
modules.summary: Reproduce the synthetic operating-characteristics grid for washout and the ICH M13A 5% predose rule.

actions.label: Run carryover study
actions.description: Runs the grid and rebuilds the tables and figures.

modules.persistence: CSV results, figures and regenerated page stay in the private project.
modules.customization: Inspect the source configuration and Monte Carlo precision through Open folder before changing scenarios. Retain the original example as the baseline.
modules.limits: Exploratory synthetic method study. Residual subtraction is a sensitivity analysis, not a regulatory recommendation.

modules.title: C-QTc hysteresis study
modules.summary: Reproduce the synthetic scenarios and operating characteristics for a prespecified concentration–QTc hysteresis check.
modules.runtime: Base R; nlme for a test cross-check

actions.label: Run C-QTc study
actions.description: The full simulation can take several minutes.

modules.persistence: Results and the regenerated method page stay in the private project.
modules.customization: Review scenarios and model assumptions in the project source. The button reproduces the existing synthetic study.
modules.limits: An exploratory synthetic method study. It does not replace a prespecified clinical C-QTc analysis or regulatory review.

modules.title: Paired SAS and R TLF libraries
modules.summary: Browse 221 SAS and 221 matching R pseudocode programs across parallel, crossover, single-sequence, SAD and MAD designs.
modules.runtime: Browser to browse; licensed SAS or R 4.4+ and an editor to implement

actions.label: Parse R templates
actions.description: Checks syntax only; no analysis is executed.

modules.persistence: The complete paired libraries are included in each private project. Save edited source files in that project and export it.
modules.customization: Choose a design in each library, open the setup helper in your editor, and implement paths, ADaM mappings, analysis populations, methods, shells and dictionary versions. Keep corresponding SAS/R stems together.
modules.limits: SAS has not been executed. R templates have been parse-checked only, not run on data. Preparing a project does not make these ready-to-run study analyses.

modules.title: Validation harness
modules.summary: Run the repository’s automatic structural and numerical checks and inspect its evidence ledger.

actions.label: Run QC harness
actions.description: Checks the complete selected private project.

modules.persistence: The evidence ledger and logs stay in the private project.
modules.customization: Run the original example first. After adaptation, review which gates and reference outputs remain applicable.
modules.limits: A passing example does not validate a new study. Manual QC and AI-use sign-off remain separate; SAS/R parity is structural, not independently reconciled execution.

modules.title: Seeded-defect check
modules.summary: Measure what the QC harness catches by planting registered defects in throwaway copies of the example.
modules.runtime: R and Python; test packages for seeded defects

actions.label: Run seeded-defect check
actions.description: This longer job can take around 13 minutes; its log shows progress.

modules.persistence: Results and logs stay in the private project; the registered defects are applied to temporary copies.
modules.customization: Inspect the registered list and known scope before running. Changes to the registry require its documented freeze and review process.
modules.limits: Counts describe a hand-picked list, not an estimated defect-detection rate. A change with no effect on shipped data may be classified equivalent.

modules.title: TLF text number validator
modules.summary: Run known-answer checks for the deterministic validator and inspect the draft-report skeleton.
modules.runtime: Base R for self-test; separate model/Python/Quarto setup for adaptation

actions.label: Run number-validator self-test
actions.description: Tests the deterministic validator without a language model.

modules.persistence: Self-test evidence is in the job log. Source changes and any later reviewed draft outputs belong in the private project.
modules.customization: Use Open folder to map aggregate TLF result datasets to fact extractors. Model configuration is preparatory; installing a model and evaluating its drafts are separate work.
modules.limits: Only the model-free/stub path has been exercised. The validator checks that digits exist in supplied facts, not whether a valid number is attached to the right claim.

modules.title: SAS/R monitoring automation
modules.summary: Prepare a study configuration for deterministic checks, evidence packets, heartbeats and notifications.
modules.runtime: Licensed SAS, or a reviewed R environment; scheduler and SMTP configured separately
modules.persistence: Prepared settings and template source stay in the private project. A deployed service needs its own persistent state, logs and backups.
modules.customization: Fill study identifier, paths, feed mappings and routing in the configuration form, then open the template project in SAS or R. Review thresholds and scheduler/service-account arrangements before unattended use.
modules.limits: SAS templates have not been executed. The toolkit does not schedule monitoring, connect clinical feeds or send monitoring emails; configuration/export does not validate a service.

modules.title: SAS/R monitoring coverage wiki
modules.summary: Read the monitoring coverage reference and its worked examples alongside the runnable TRIALMON card.
modules.persistence: The reference and supporting files are included in the private project.
modules.customization: Use the reference to write a study-specific monitoring and coverage plan; use TRIALMON for the synthetic interactive example.
modules.limits: Reference material and examples do not configure feeds or authorize clinical decisions.

modules.title: Coverage playbook and runbook
modules.summary: Plan planned leave, unplanned absence, role handoff, taking over and single-owner exposure.
modules.persistence: Save your completed handoff through the separate continuity workspace’s JSON/CSV/print controls.
modules.customization: Choose a scenario and populate your named owners, backups, schedules and escalation contacts in the continuity workspace.
modules.limits: The playbook is a reference. It does not automatically provide cover, schedule jobs or send messages.

modules.title: LOCALMIND SAS/R helpers
modules.summary: Prepare a local language-model helper project for constrained classification, extraction and drafting.
modules.runtime: Licensed SAS or R with httr2/jsonlite; separately installed local model service
modules.persistence: Prepared settings and copied SAS/R source stay in the private project. Save model identity, digest and reviewed outputs alongside any later evaluation.
modules.customization: Provide the loopback endpoint, pinned model identity, seed and controlled labels. Open the source in SAS or an R editor to map the intended language-only task.
modules.limits: Configuration does not install a model, accept its license, start a model service or demonstrate draft quality. No production model run is promised; numerical work stays in SAS/R.

modules.title: Biostatistics deliverables register
modules.summary: Explore 132 early-phase deliverables, their owners, inputs, outputs, standards and QC methods.
modules.runtime: Browser, PDF reader or spreadsheet application
modules.persistence: Save edited workbook/document copies within the private project and export it.
modules.customization: Open the register in your spreadsheet application and adapt deliverables, ownership and evidence for the intended study.
modules.limits: A reference map, not a record of completed study work or a generated submission package.

modules.title: eCRF assist apps
modules.summary: Open four separately hosted Python demos: coding QC, de-identification review, participant risk and central monitoring.
modules.runtime: Browser; separately hosted Python runtime downloads on first use
modules.persistence: Separate demo site; its code and runtime are not included in this toolkit project ZIP.
modules.customization: Use the synthetic public demos. For local adaptation, download that separate repository and follow its own setup guide.
modules.limits: Uploads are disabled in the public demos. Placeholder coding is not MedDRA. The host/CDN sees your IP address; this is not a validated or Part 11 system.

modules.title: Within-sibling coding evaluation
modules.summary: Read the separate eCRF coding-assist evaluation, including its within-sibling comparison and observed failures.
modules.persistence: Read-only external evidence; reproduction belongs to the separately downloaded eCRF repository.
modules.customization: Read the evaluation before adapting the coding-assist example. Retain its human review and test assumptions in any new work.
modules.limits: Synthetic evaluation results do not establish performance on a new study or coding dictionary.
